subject: Post-call: security & retention alignment — evidence worklist and next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@northgatefinance.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@northgatefinance.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: security & retention alignment — evidence worklist and next steps

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the concrete asks from our side so we can keep momentum toward procurement next month. I’ve grouped items by priority to make it easier for your security and procurement teams.

Summary of pain/goals we heard
- Must have: SOC 2 Type II, audit log access for key events, and documented retention policies for user data (90–365d depending on data class).
- Important: Ability to run customer-scoped pen tests / provide a pen-test scope and point of contact.
- Preferable: Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with specific retention clauses and a sample of anonymized audit logs for integration testing.

Actionable evidence asks (what we can provide immediately)
1) SOC 2 summary & mapping (attachment: SOC2-summary-ask.pdf) — includes controls matrix and locations of artifacts.
2) Small audit log sample (attachment: audit-log-sample.csv) — redacted sample showing events you requested (auth, model calls, data export).
3) Draft DPA with typical redlines (attachment: DPA-draft-redlines.docx) — happy to accept your edits; we can route to legal once kernel items are agreed.
4) Pen-test scope and requirements (attachment: pen-test-scope.pdf) — includes scheduling and approved testing windows.

Next steps / timelines
- You: Confirm which artifacts you want first (SOC2 artifact pack vs. full evidence room) and whether legal prefers to start with our DPA or your template. Please reply by end of week (Fri 24 Sep).
- Us: We’ll upload the full SOC2 artifact pack to the shared evidence folder and enable a read-only link for your security reviewers within 48 hours of your confirmation.
- Pen test: if you want to proceed, give us preferred test week windows (we’ll need 2–3 weeks lead time).

If it helps, I can set a 30-min follow-up with our security lead (Evelyn) and you to walk artifacts and answer technical questions. Proposed times: Tue 21 Sep 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 22 Sep 13:00–14:00 PT.

Thanks — Jordan
--
Jordan Blake

Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:23:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: security & retention alignment — evidence worklist and next steps

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary and the files. Quick responses from our side: we want the full SOC 2 artifact pack + the audit log sample to validate event names and retention behavior.

A few clarifying Qs before we engage legal:
- Retention windows: you mentioned 90–365d depending on data class. Can you confirm the retention for user-generated content vs. system telemetry? We need explicit numbers for our DPA.
- Audit log fields: can you confirm whether API key identifiers are hashed or stored in plain text in logs? We prefer hashed values or a mapping workflow.
- Pen-test: we will require a standard test agreement and a list of allowed IP ranges for the test. Preferred testing windows: Oct 4–8 or Oct 18–22.

Also looped in Priya (procurement) — Priya, our legal team will want the DPA draft to compare to our template. If Redwood can accept a couple of redlines, we can circulate a counter.

Best — Alex

[Alex Mercer
Head of Risk & Compliance, Northgate Finance]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: security & retention alignment — evidence worklist and next steps

Alex / Priya — answers inline and next steps below. Evelyn — can you confirm ETA for SOC2 pack and log redaction?

Answers to Alex’s questions:
- Retention windows: user-generated content (defined as customer data we store on behalf of Northgate) = default 180 days, configurable to 90/365 on contract; system telemetry (platform health metrics, anonymized) = 30 days active, aggregated 12 months. We’ll list these in the DPA table.
- API key identifiers: stored hashed by default (SHA-256) in audit logs. For customers requiring mapping we support a secure key vault mapping workflow; we can discuss scopes.
- Pen-test: we accept your requested windows Oct 4–8 or Oct 18–22 — please pick one and we’ll reserve capacity. We’ll also provide the standard test agreement and approved IP ranges once you select dates.

Immediate next steps (what we’ll do this week)
1) Evelyn to upload SOC2 artifact pack to shared folder and enable read-only link (ETA: 24 Sep).
2) I’ll update the DPA-draft-redlines.docx to include explicit retention table and the API-key handling language; we’ll send to Priya by 24 Sep for legal review.
3) Audit log sample: Evelyn will produce an additional CSV with column definitions and redaction notes (ETA: 24 Sep).

Can you confirm which pen-test week you prefer and whether legal wants us to redline your DPA template or start from ours? If you prefer a call, can we schedule 30 min on Thu 24 Sep 11:00–11:30 PT?

Thanks — Jordan
